decisions.reason: As a close-to-core LED track spotlight in a growing lighting market, it is a relatively low-cost option to keep open and there is no clear negative signal yet that would justify abandoning it after only its launch year.

As a close-to-core LED ceiling luminaire that fits the firm's broad design-led range and dealer/planner support model, management would likely retain it while market uncertainty resolves because no adverse evidence has yet emerged.
